benchmark.name: contract_overhead

config.order: same process; within each (batch, iteration) every package runs once, in an order drawn from random.Random(seed); warmup uses the same scheme

stages.label: Authorization receipt
stages.production_operation: ControlPlane.authorize (with the host resource registry and selections)

stages.label: Host revalidation and lease
stages.production_operation: ControlPlane.validate_input + run_plan + summary + authorization [+ evaluate_tools when tools are bound] + issue_execution_lease

stages.label: Workflow instantiation and start checks
stages.production_operation: ExecutionSession('execution.run') until Workflow dispatches its first wave

benchmark.host_resources: The host holds resources (fixtures/host-resource-registry.json, the WebAir demo's host resources file). As the plugin's backend does on such a host, every authorize carries the resource registry and the package's selections (empty when it requests no host resource) and every prepare_run_plan carries the registry, for every package.

refused: runner outbound frames other than execution.progress

software.note: Node and OpenClaw do not run in the measured process. Node generated the host fixtures once (fixtures/generate_fixtures.mjs) through the plugin's own code; the OpenClaw version is the one the plugin verifies and the fixtures name.

environment_note: No username, home directory, hostname or serial number is recorded. Paths are repository-relative.
